snippet.title: Teen Cheezein Jo Maut Ke Baad Bhi Kaam Aati Hain | Sahih Muslim 1631 #shorts
snippet.description:
Jab insaan duniya se chala jata hai, to us ke saath kya jata hai?

Hamare Nabi Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Ta'ala Alaihi Wa Aalihi Wasallam) ne farmaya (Abu Huraira Radi Allahu Anhu se riwayat):
«إِذَا مَاتَ الإِنْسَانُ انْقَطَعَ عَنْهُ عَمَلُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ إِلاَّ مِنْ صَدَقَةٍ جَارِيَةٍ أَوْ عِلْمٍ يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ أَوْ وَلَدٍ صَالِحٍ يَدْعُو لَهُ»
"Jab insaan faut ho jata hai, to us ke amal khatam ho jate hain, siwaye teen cheezon ke: sadqa-e-jariya, aisa ilm jis se faida uthaya jaye, aur nek aulad jo us ke liye dua kare."

Reference
• Sahih Muslim 1631: https://sunnah.com/muslim:1631

Ek kunwan, ek masjid, ek Quran Pak, ya kisi ko sikhai hui ek dua. Aaj koi ek aisa nek kaam shuru karein jo aap ke baad bhi chalta rahe. Yeh video aage bhejein, yeh bhi ek aur sadqah hai. One more sadqah 🤍
